---
ont:
  id: core.EvidenceScope
  type: concept
  labels:
  - Evidence Scope
  synonyms:
  - claim boundary
  - observation limit
  - proof scope
  description: Constrains a record to facts actually observed and prevents stronger
    delivery or model-input claims.
  examples:
  - state provider=false when unobserved
  - distinguish inference from proof
  anti_examples:
  - upgrade a proxy into final evidence
---
